title: Chapter 504
text:
Without any skills, they did not have the qualifications to be locked up in the Bell of Death Island.

The majority of the prisoners had committed countless crimes, and the reason why the Six Nations kept them alive and locked them up in an unknown place was because they had taken a fancy to their talents and hoped to squeeze all their value out of them.

It could also be understood that the Bell of Death Island was a place where the Six Nations stored their talents.

A portion of the prisoners had reached an agreement with the Six Nations, using their talents to exchange for better treatment. However, the majority of the prisoners scoffed at this and mocked the representatives of the Six Nations time and time again. They were arrogant and cruel like poisonous beasts. The prison guards were instead afraid of them, and many of the prisoners were forbidden from coming into close contact with them.

Just yesterday, the Six Nations had lost contact with the Bell of Death Island. With the calamity sweeping across the entire world, the Six Nations could not even protect themselves and could not care about the Bell of Death Island.

What the Six Nations did not know was that the Bell of Death Island was also affected by the Mutation Disaster. The prison guards had fallen ill on a large scale, and their duties had all been thrown to the back of their minds.

Some of the prison guards had even opened the metal doors of a portion of the prisoners, and it was as though they had released a ferocious tiger from its collar.

…

Puchi!

Fresh blood spurted out from the human bodies and dyed the gray metal corridor red. The incandescent lamp in the middle of the ceiling was dyed red, and the light in the corridor was dyed red.

A 2.2-meter-tall muscular Sharnuk threw away the corpse of the prison guard that had been torn into two pieces, and the two pieces fell to the ground with a loud thud.

The muscular man's upper body was naked, and his muscles were fully exposed. His body was covered with old scars and the natural patterns of the Sharnuk people. He was bald, and to be precise, all the male prisoners had been shaved bald.

The muscular man flung the blood off his hands and turned around to take a look. There were more than ten prison guard corpses on the ground, and the prison guard that had been torn apart by him was among them. Hundreds of yellow bullet shells were scattered in the pool of blood, and there were also many guns that had been crushed by him. The stench of blood lingered in the air.

The prisoners were all locked up individually, and the cells were separated by a few hundred meters. There were large metal doors on both sides of the corridor, and every cell was a sealed space.

Looking around, there were no windows in this corridor. The muscular man punched the wall a few times, leaving a shallow dent. The feedback of his strength showed that behind the wall was a very thick metal and concrete. There were only two choices in front of him: to move forward or to retreat.

Ever since he was locked up, the brawny man had never left his cell. Naturally, he did not know the layout of the prison map. He was too lazy to change into the prison uniform that was too small. He glanced at the monitor in the corner.

"Suddenly opening my cell door, and until now, no one has come to stop me … Hmm, the air is filled with a dangerous smell. What happened to this prison?" The brawny man muttered to himself.

Being locked up on Bell of Death Island, all the prisoners were cut off from the outside world. Naturally, they did not know about the Mutation Disaster.

Without hesitation, the burly man decided to move forward. After walking for a few hundred meters, a metal gate blocked his path. He touched the thickness of the metal gate and took a deep breath. He took a stance and pulled his right fist to his side like a bow.

His muscles suddenly bulged, and his fist, which was the size of a casserole pot, smashed heavily on the door.

Dong! Dong! Dong!

After more than twenty consecutive punches, the crater outlined an oval outline. The brawny man lowered his shoulder and rammed into the metal. The metal was immediately torn apart and sent flying by him, opening up a passage.

After walking for a while, he finally saw the cells of this corridor. In front of the door were the corpses of several prison guards. The door was wide open, and the prisoners inside were nowhere to be seen. The prisoners of Bell of Death Island did not have the opportunity to know other prisoners, and the brawny man was no exception. He did not know who his' neighbor 'was.

He did not think too much about it and continued forward. Very soon, he saw another metal gate. However, this gate had a huge hole, and it was clearly left behind by his equally lucky neighbor.

The brawny man did not stop and walked past a few cells. Some of them did not have the corpses of the prison guards, but all the cells were opened. Clearly, they had all been saved by his neighbor. The many metal gates that blocked his path were also opened, and he was able to pass through without any obstruction.

He gradually changed from walking to jogging, wanting to catch up to the person in front.

After running for a while, he passed through a metal gate. Behind him was no longer the endless corridor of cells but a spacious circular hall. In the center was a grayish-black metal pillar that connected the ceiling to the floor. This was the elevator shaft, and it was divided into four elevators. In front of the elevator shaft was a group of prisoners. When they heard the footsteps of the brawny man, they all turned around.

"Another lucky one, and he escaped alone." A tall and skinny middle-aged prisoner walked out of the crowd and sized the brawny man up. "If you have saved other prisoners along the way, then you must be my neighbor on the other side. Let me introduce myself. I am Shijack, a senior executive of the Germinal Organization. I was imprisoned eleven years ago."

"A member of the Germinal Organization? No wonder you were captured. " The brawny man nodded and said with a deep voice, "I am Tyne. I have been imprisoned for four years. What happened in the prison? Why did someone release us, and why did no one stop us?"

"I don't know either, but since no one stopped us, this is a good opportunity to escape." Shijack pointed at the prisoners behind him and said, "They all have their own abilities. Some of them even know the terrain of Bell of Death Island. He can bring us out of here."

A skinny man walked out, pointed at his head, and said, "I once hacked into the top secret database of the Six Nations and saw the structure of Bell of Death Island. Although it was only for a few seconds, I have already memorized sixty to seventy percent of the information. It is just right for me to use it now … Humph, this is why I was captured.

"In short, Bell of Death Island is not a small island in the sea. The name is misleading, and its real location is under a mountain range. The Six Nations borrowed a natural cave to build this underground prison. There are a total of thirteen floors, and each floor is a circular corridor with many cells. The exterior of the prison is surrounded by a large amount of steel and concrete, and not even a missile can blast it open. Someone like you."

Bang!

A thick beam of light flashed.

The next moment, everything above the burned face's neck disappeared. The cut was charred, and the headless corpse shook for a moment before falling straight to the ground.

Han Xiao curled his finger, and the Floating Cannon Halo Array circled around him slowly like an obedient pet. He was not in the mood to reason with these vicious prisoners. He was expressionless.
